roleLabel: Rush-refresh melee Duelist — resets on kills and snowballs Attack Speed
bestFor: Aggressive boards that can give Nyx a tanked opener, then let her chain Wild Flurry resets
strength: Kill resets re-cast her combo; Ferality stacks Attack Speed/Attack per Rush trigger across the fight
weakness: Needs the first 10–20 seconds covered — if she eats the opener she never starts the reset train

howToPlay.early: Do not start her alone on the dive tile. Buy a tank or let someone else eat the first hit (community clears even mention Rank B Nyx needing early tanking). Rank her once she can live to the first kill.
howToPlay.mid: Keen-Eyed = execute threshold for Assassins/Duelists (Backup). Wild/Ferality = Rush AS stacking carry. Spark = Stall DoTs on autos. Most “Nyx carry” runs want Ferality + Rush relics.
howToPlay.late: Stack Rush and Attack Speed. Keep feeding kills so Wild Flurry jumps. Crit/execute tools pair with Keen-Eyed boards.
howToPlay.positioning: Mid lane slightly off the first-contact tile — close enough to leap between kills, far enough not to eat the opening volley.

abilityNotes.Wild Flurry: The reset on kill is the hero. Target order matters: set up a killable first target so she chains into the rest.

specNotes.The Keen-Eyed: Team execute for Assassins/Duelists. Take when you run that tribal and want Cleanup, not only Nyx damage.
specNotes.The Wild: Ferality / Rush stacking carry path — default when Nyx is your main DPS.
specNotes.The Spark: Stall DoT autos (Burn → Frost → more). Take on Stall boards; weaker if fights are pure Rush races.

relicReasons.duelists-rhythm-prism-3008: Attack Speed / rhythm tools feed both Ferality and Wild Flurry hit count.
relicReasons.duelists-outbreak-banner-571: Duelist banner for the class you drafted.
relicReasons.duelists-fury-filigree-3010: Aggression filigree that supports her reset-carry tempo.

faq.question: Is Nyx good in Guildrun?
faq.answer: One of the highest ceilings in the Demo when protected early. One of the worst feels if she tanks the opener. Buy her with a plan for who eats the first hit.

faq.question: What class is Nyx?
faq.answer: Duelist. Role focus: Rush-refresh melee carry who re-casts on kills and stacks Ferality.

faq.question: What relics work with Nyx?
faq.answer: Duelist Rhythm/Outbreak/Fury pieces, Rush amplifiers, and Attack Speed. Add Stall tools only if you took Spark.

faq.question: How do you play Nyx?
faq.answer: Tank the opener for her, stack Rush/AS, let Wild Flurry reset on kills, and take Wild/Ferality for solo carry or Keen-Eyed for Assassin/Duelist tribal.

tips: If she dies first every fight, you do not need more Attack — you need a tank and better placement.
Reset chaining fails when the first target is too tanky; soften or aim her at the squishy.
